text.zh: 他是单亲家庭的独子，始终不认识自己的生父。
text.en: The only child of a single parent, he never got to know his father.

text.zh: 他住在 Twickenham 一家由慈善机构资助的儿童之家（Shaftesbury Homes）。
text.en: He lived in a charity-supported Shaftesbury Homes children's home in Twickenham.

text.zh: 他说不再想当电影明星，而是要当一名电气工程师。
text.en: He said he had given up the idea of being a film star and would become an electrical engineer.

text.zh: 他和母亲一起生活，并说自己没有父亲。
text.en: He lives with his mother and says he has no father.

text.zh: 他已于前一年圣诞节离开 Twickenham 的儿童之家，搬回与母亲同住。
text.en: He lives with his mother, having left the Twickenham children's home the previous Christmas.

text.zh: 拍摄前一年的圣诞节，他离开儿童之家，回到母亲身边生活。
text.en: At Christmas before filming he left the children's home and returned to live with his mother.

text.zh: 他说没有父亲并未影响他：从来没有的东西，也就不会想念。
text.en: He says growing up without a father has not affected him: what you don't have, you don't miss.

text.zh: 他在 Walls 肉食公司的冷冻车间工作，公司离他在 Middlesex 的家不远。
text.en: He works in the freezer room at Walls, a meat company near his home in Middlesex.

text.zh: 他和母亲同住，两人相处更像朋友；他觉得自己必须保护她。
text.en: He lives with his mother, gets on with her more like a friend, and feels he must protect her.

text.zh: 离开儿童之家后，他已在 Middlesex 与母亲同住了八年。
text.en: He has lived with his mother in Middlesex for eight years since leaving the children's home.

text.zh: 他说自己就是喜欢辛苦活，重复的工作从没让他烦恼，但不能一辈子待在 Walls。
text.en: He says he likes hard work and routine jobs have never worried him, but he can't stay at Walls forever.

text.zh: 他仍在 Walls 工作，已干了八九年，无意往上升当主管。
text.en: He still works at Walls after eight or nine years and has no wish to become a manager.

text.zh: 他与 Yvonne 结婚，育有五个孩子：三个男孩、两个女孩。
text.en: He is married to Yvonne and they have five children, three boys and two girls.

text.zh: 他和家人住在伦敦的一套市政公寓里。
text.en: He and his family live in a council flat in London.

text.zh: 21 岁之后，他与 Yvonne 结婚；到 28 岁时两人已有五个孩子。
text.en: Since 21 he has married Yvonne; by 28 they had five children.

text.zh: 他只想轻松自在地过一生，并说自己想要的都已经有了。
text.en: He wants to get through life nice and easy, and says he already has what he wants.

text.zh: （事后得知）他拒绝参与本片：当时他刚失去母亲，又正在经历艰难的离婚。
text.en: (Learned later) He declined to take part, having recently lost his mother and while going through a hard divorce.

text.zh: 拍摄前约两年，他去考 GCSE 数学，并顺利通过。
text.en: About two years before filming he studied for GCSE Maths and passed.

text.zh: Walls 倒闭后，他做过几份仓库工作，现为航空货运公司 Yusen 开叉车。
text.en: After Walls closed and several warehouse jobs, he drives a forklift truck for the airfreight company Yusen.

text.zh: 他娶了 Vienetta，有四岁的儿子 Daniel、继女 Miriam，及前段婚姻的五个孩子。
text.en: Married to Vienetta, he has a four-year-old son, Daniel, a stepdaughter, Miriam, and five children from his first marriage.

text.zh: 28 岁后，他与 Yvonne 离婚，母亲 1990 年死于癌症，他又娶了 Vienetta。
text.en: Since 28 he divorced Yvonne, lost his mother to cancer in 1990, and married Vienetta.

text.zh: 他说 Vienetta 激励他、照顾他，让他觉得有人真正需要他。
text.en: He says Vienetta motivates and looks after him, making him feel that someone really wants him.

text.zh: Walls 工厂关闭后，他一直在 Heathrow 机场附近处理货运。
text.en: Since Walls closed its factory, he has worked near Heathrow Airport handling freight.

text.zh: 妻子 Vienetta，儿子 Daniel，还有继女；前五个子女中三人与他来往；两个孙辈。
text.en: Married to Vienetta, with son Daniel and a stepdaughter; three of his five older children see him, and he has two grandchildren.

text.zh: 他和 Vienetta 住的房子能望见 Windsor 城堡。
text.en: He and Vienetta live in a house from which Windsor Castle can be seen.

text.zh: 约两年前，他和 Vienetta 决定受训做寄养父母；Paul 从澳大利亚飞来看望他。
text.en: A couple of years earlier he and Vienetta decided to train as foster parents; Paul was flown from Australia to visit him.

text.zh: 他承认自己上学时很懒，但并不介意：人是为生活而工作，不是为工作而活。
text.en: He admits he was lazy at school but isn't troubled by it: you work to live, not live to work.

text.zh: 他是叉车操作员，在 Heathrow 附近处理货运，并与 Vienetta 一起寄养孩子。
text.en: He works as a forklift operator handling freight near Heathrow, and fosters children with Vienetta.

text.zh: 他与 Vienetta 结婚；儿子 Daniel 刚满 18 岁；女儿 Jess 是第一段婚姻所生。
text.en: He is married to Vienetta; their son Daniel has just turned 18, and his daughter Jess is from his first marriage.

text.zh: 儿子 Daniel 满 18 岁，考试通过，并获得 Procter & Gamble 的学徒职位。
text.en: His son Daniel turned 18, passed his exams and won an apprenticeship with Procter & Gamble.

text.zh: 他和 Vienetta 说，犯错不等于走到尽头，他们的生活顺境多于逆境。
text.en: He and Vienetta say a mistake isn't the end of the road, and their life has had more ups than downs.

text.zh: 他和 Vienetta 仍在做寄养；约四年前，他们得知已照顾过一百三十多个孩子。
text.en: He and Vienetta are still fostering; about four years earlier they were told they had cared for 130-odd children.

text.zh: 他仍与 Vienetta 是夫妻，有十个孙辈；与前段婚姻子女的关系正在修复。
text.en: Still married to Vienetta, he has ten grandchildren, and his relationship with his first-marriage children is mending.

text.zh: 他住在英格兰；多年来 Paul 和 Sue 回英格兰时会去看望他和 Vienetta。
text.en: He lives in England, where Paul and Sue have visited him and Vienetta over the years.

text.zh: 前一年他召集全家为 Vienetta 庆生；之后两人首次飞往澳大利亚探望 Paul。
text.en: He gathered his whole family for Vienetta's birthday the year before, and they made a first trip to Australia to visit Paul.

text.zh: 被问若去了澳大利亚人生是否不同，他说人生就是现在这样，而非本可能的样子。
text.en: Asked if moving to Australia would have changed his life, he says your life is as it is, not as it could be.

text.zh: 他与第二任妻子在约二十年间寄养了一百多名孩子。
text.en: He and his second wife have fostered more than 100 children over about 20 years.

text.zh: 他仍与第二任妻子 Vienetta 在一起；片中可见他与部分家人在一起。
text.en: He and his second wife, Vienetta, are still together, and the film shows him with some of his family.

text.zh: 他先在香肠厂冷冻车间工作，后来开叉车处理机场货运。他与第二任妻子在约二十年间寄养了一百多名孩子。
text.en: He worked in a sausage-factory freezer room, then as a forklift driver handling airport freight. With his second wife he has fostered more than 100 children over some 20 years.
